items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Lee and Freia got their marriage papers and as they were living in a hotel room, we offered them the use of our appartment to have their wedding reception.

ctx.x: I came back to Paris and the Trois Mailletz the 22nd of May. Life was great. We had our little appartment that Lily had furnished in a very beautiful way. No more hotel or old furnished places for us. We started to invite friends and give parties. One of them, we shall never forget.

There were many G.I's in Paris as SHAPE was in Versailles, a few miles from Paris. Lily and I became friends with an Ex-G.I. named Robert E. Lee. who was a coloured man and quite a character. Lee could get things for us from the P.X. that we could not get in shops in Paris or if it was possible in shops, it costed less in the P.X. So we became better friends with Lee who was engaged to a pretty blonde German girl named Freia.

Lee and Freia got their marriage papers and as they were living in a hotel room, we offered them the use of our appartment to have their wedding reception. We asked Lee how many people he was inviting and he said about 15, which would be quite a crowd for our small place. Lily
